nodes.name: buildPackageDriftOverview.ts
nodes.summary: Pure selectors that pivot distributed package data into a per-package drift overview (artifacts, installs, pending work) plus counting, status and sorting helpers.

nodes.name: ensurePackage
nodes.summary: Gets or creates a package drift accumulator entry.

nodes.name: ensureArtifact
nodes.summary: Gets or creates an artifact drift entry within a package.

nodes.name: deployedDriftReason
nodes.summary: Computes the drift reason for a deployed artifact.

nodes.name: pushStandard
nodes.summary: Adds a deployed standard into the package drift overview.

nodes.name: pushCommand
nodes.summary: Adds a deployed command into the package drift overview.

nodes.name: pushSkill
nodes.summary: Adds a deployed skill into the package drift overview.

nodes.name: pushPendingStandard
nodes.summary: Adds a not-yet-distributed standard into the overview.

nodes.name: pushPendingCommand
nodes.summary: Adds a not-yet-distributed command into the overview.

nodes.name: pushPendingSkill
nodes.summary: Adds a not-yet-distributed skill into the overview.

nodes.name: sortArtifacts
nodes.summary: Sorts artifacts by drift and name.

nodes.name: sortInstallLocations
nodes.summary: Sorts install locations of a package.

nodes.name: buildPackageDriftOverview
nodes.summary: Builds per-package drift overviews from distributed package data.

nodes.name: packageHasDrift
nodes.summary: Whether a package has any drifting install.

nodes.name: packageHasSendableWork
nodes.summary: Whether a package has installs that can be distributed now.

nodes.name: packageRepositoryCount
nodes.summary: Counts distinct repositories a package is installed in.

nodes.name: packageBehindInstallCount
nodes.summary: Counts installs of a package that are behind.

nodes.name: packageSendableInstallCount
nodes.summary: Counts installs of a package that can be sent.

nodes.name: totalBehindInstallCount
nodes.summary: Totals behind installs across packages.

nodes.name: packageHasFailedDistribution
nodes.summary: Whether any install's last distribution failed.

nodes.name: packageIsWaiting
nodes.summary: Whether a package's drift is only waiting on in-progress distributions.

nodes.name: packageFailedInstallCount
nodes.summary: Counts installs whose last distribution failed.

nodes.name: totalFailedInstallCount
nodes.summary: Totals failed installs across packages.

nodes.name: packageAttentionInstallCount
nodes.summary: Counts installs needing attention (behind or failed).

nodes.name: sortPackagesByDriftFirst
nodes.summary: Sorts packages with drifting ones first.

nodes.name: buildRepositoryDriftOverview.ts
nodes.summary: Selectors pivoting package drift overviews into a per-repository/target view with drift, failure, lock profile and activity helpers and drift-first sorting.

nodes.name: buildRepositoryDriftOverview
nodes.summary: Pivots package drift overviews into per-repository/target drift overviews.

nodes.name: targetDriftedPackageCount
nodes.summary: Counts drifted packages on a target.

nodes.name: targetFailedPackageCount
nodes.summary: Counts packages with failed distribution on a target.

nodes.name: repositoryHasDrift
nodes.summary: Whether a repository has any drift.

nodes.name: repositoryHasFailedDistribution
nodes.summary: Whether a repository has failed distributions.

nodes.name: repositoryBehindInstallCount
nodes.summary: Counts behind installs in a repository.

nodes.name: repositoryFailedInstallCount
nodes.summary: Counts failed installs in a repository.

nodes.name: repositoryDriftedTargetCount
nodes.summary: Counts drifted targets in a repository.

nodes.name: repositoryPackageCount
nodes.summary: Counts distinct packages in a repository.

nodes.name: repositoryDriftedPackageCount
nodes.summary: Counts distinct drifted packages in a repository.

nodes.name: collectPackageIds
nodes.summary: Collects package ids from a repository's targets, optionally filtered.

nodes.name: totalDriftedRepoCount
nodes.summary: Counts drifted repositories.

nodes.name: totalFailedRepoCount
nodes.summary: Counts repositories with failed distributions.

nodes.name: repositoryLastActivityAt
nodes.summary: Returns the latest distribution activity date of a repository.

nodes.name: repositoryLockProfile
nodes.summary: Aggregates the lock profile across a repository's installs.

nodes.name: repositoryDriftIsWaiting
nodes.summary: Whether a repository's drift is only waiting on in-progress distributions.

nodes.name: sortRepositoriesByDriftFirst
